selection: Seeded 32 whole reactions from each frozen v0.8 geometry region; all adapters receive all same selected frames. No labels enter reaction selection.

architecture.routing: Atomic number H/C/N/O only; dense evaluation of two residual experts plus always-on shared branch
architecture.backbone: Frozen global512; retain coordinate gradients through even scalar MACE descriptors
architecture.single_head: Width48 compared with three width16 branches; 49248 vs49256 trainable adapter parameters on accepted backbone

training.checkpoint: Final epoch only, retain initial zero-residual baseline; no early selection or retry

evaluation.meta_development: Not used for fitting adapters; no additional residual pilot evaluation in this first finite batch
evaluation.metrics: Energy curves mixed/optimized before barriers; global and TS Cartesian force RMSE weighted by actual component counts

promotion: Require shared_experts to lower validation barrier MAE and not worsen global/TS force RMSE vs frozen global512; to attribute any benefit to experts it must also beat the matched single-head adapter. This short pilot only permits larger matched training/repeats, not independent-generalization claims or prospective opening.
prerequisites: External soft-mixture pilot and real shared-backbone force-gradient/serialization/symmetry interface acceptance must already be complete. Existing Mac paired queue must be completed and its owner lock available.
